  //     - Clinton : 48 inchangé (Math.max(48, 40) = 48)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  {
    const HEAVY_O = new Set(["Saturne", "Pluton", "Uranus", "Neptune"]);
    const HARD_O = new Set(["Conjonction", "Carré", "Opposition"]);
    const FIN_HOUSES_O = new Set([2, 5, 8]);

    const jupHouse = payload._natalDict?.["Jupiter"]?.house;
    if (jupHouse && FIN_HOUSES_O.has(jupHouse)) {
      const oHits = findTransitHits(payload, h => {
        if (h.isProg) return false;
        const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
        return HEAVY_O.has(tP)
          && HARD_O.has(h.aspectName)
          && h.natalP === "Jupiter"
          && isFinite(h.orb) && h.orb <= 0.3;
      });

      if (oHits.length > 0) {
        const ranked = Object.entries(finalScores).filter(([,v])=>v>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k])=>k);
        const rankOf = (sig) => ranked.indexOf(sig);

        let oReason = null;
        for (const h of oHits) {
          const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
          oReason = `${tP} ${h.aspectName} Jupiter@M${jupHouse} orbe=${h.orb}°`;
          break;
        }

        // Floor doctrinal sans boost multiplicatif (la signature seule justifie
        // que FINANCE_DOWN accroche le top 5, mais sans écraser les top1-2).
        if (rankOf("FINANCE_DOWN") !== 0 && rankOf("FINANCE_DOWN") !== 1) {
          const baseScore = finalScores["FINANCE_DOWN"] || 0;
          const newScore = Math.max(baseScore, 40);
          if (newScore > baseScore) {
            finalScores["FINANCE_DOWN"] = newScore;
            breakdown["FINANCE_DOWN"] = breakdown["FINANCE_DOWN"] || {};
            breakdown["FINANCE_DOWN"].final = newScore;
            breakdown["FINANCE_DOWN"].chanceBrokenFloor = 40;
            breakdown["FINANCE_DOWN"].chanceBrokenReason = oReason;
          }
        }
      }
    }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Note 235 — Phase D : Mars-dominant Guard sur ACCIDENT (Gemini)
  //   Doctrine astrologique (Gemini Note 235) :
  //   « Pour qu'il y ait un ACCIDENT majeur, Mars doit agir comme
  //     déclencheur (l'étincelle) sur une poudrière déjà en place
  //     (transits lourds d'Uranus, Pluton, Saturne, ou éclipses sur
  //     des points sensibles). Mars seul ne provoque qu'un incident
  //     mineur. »
  //
  //   Mesure quantitative sur panel 26 :
  //     Vrais positifs ACCIDENT (Reeve, Kahlo, Lauda) :
  //       part Mars / (Mars + Heavy) = 38-54%
  //     Faux positifs ACCIDENT (Clinton, Berlusconi, Weiner, Jackie,
  //     Aniston) : part Mars = 83-100%, Heavy quasi nul.
  //
  //   Règle : si Mars contribue > 65% du score ACCIDENT et que la
  //   contribution Heavy (Saturne/Pluton/Uranus/Chiron en transit)
  //   est < 1.5 → ACCIDENT = score × 0.4 (le score reflète l'étincelle
  //   Mars sans la poudrière → incident mineur, pas accident majeur).
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  {
    const HARD_ACC = new Set(["Conjonction", "Carré", "Opposition", "Quinconce"]);
    const ACC_PLANETS_W = { "Mars": 1.0, "Pluton": 0.9, "Saturne": 0.8, "Uranus": 0.7,
                            "Ascendant": 1.0, "Milieu du Ciel": 0.3, "Chiron": 0.8 };
    const ACC_HOUSES_W = { 1: 1.0, 8: 0.8, 6: 0.6 };
    const ACC_ASP_W = { "Conjonction": 1.0, "Carré": 0.8, "Opposition": 0.8, "Quinconce": 0.5 };
    const HEAVY_TRANS = new Set(["Saturne", "Pluton", "Uranus", "Chiron"]);

    let marsContrib = 0;
    let heavyContrib = 0;
    const hits = findTransitHits(payload, h => {
      if (h.isProg) return false;
      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      if (!HARD_ACC.has(h.aspectName)) return false;
      const pT = ACC_PLANETS_W[tP] || 0.1;
      const pN = ACC_PLANETS_W[h.natalP] || 0.1;
      if (pT * pN < 0.3) return false;
      const hw = ACC_HOUSES_W[h.transitHouse] || 0;
      if (hw === 0) return false;
      if (!isFinite(h.orb) || h.orb > 2) return false;
      return true;
    });

    for (const h of hits) {
      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      const pT = ACC_PLANETS_W[tP] || 0.1;
      const pN = ACC_PLANETS_W[h.natalP] || 0.1;
      const aw = ACC_ASP_W[h.aspectName] || 0;
      const hw = ACC_HOUSES_W[h.transitHouse] || 0;
      const s = pT * pN * aw * hw;
      if (tP === "Mars") marsContrib += s;
      else if (HEAVY_TRANS.has(tP)) heavyContrib += s;
    }

    const total = marsContrib + heavyContrib;
    const marsRatio = total > 0 ? marsContrib / total : 0;
    if (marsRatio > 0.65 && heavyContrib < 1.5 && (finalScores["ACCIDENT"] || 0) > 0) {
      const baseScore = finalScores["ACCIDENT"];
      const newScore = Math.round(baseScore * 0.4);
      finalScores["ACCIDENT"] = newScore;
      breakdown["ACCIDENT"] = breakdown["ACCIDENT"] || {};
      breakdown["ACCIDENT"].final = newScore;
      breakdown["ACCIDENT"].marsDominantGuard = 0.4;
      breakdown["ACCIDENT"].marsDominantRatio = marsRatio.toFixed(2);
      breakdown["ACCIDENT"].marsDominantHeavy = heavyContrib.toFixed(2);
      // On préserve le score pré-guard pour que le crisis override puisse
      // toujours se déclencher (Mars dur sur Asc/M8 = tension réelle qui
      // empêche un CARRIERE_UP de haut score, même si pas d'accident grave).
      breakdown["ACCIDENT"].accidentPreGuard = baseScore;
    }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Note 237 — Phase E : Junon-Dominant Guard sur MARIAGE (Gemini)
  //   Doctrine astrologique (Gemini Note 237) :
  //   « Junon est l'astéroïde de l'engagement et du partenariat. Son
  //     transit sur DS ou planètes clés met en lumière les *thèmes*

  //     doux. Junon seul = thème conjugal, voire crise conjugale. »

  //     Vrais positifs MARIAGE :
  //       Kate Middleton 2011 : Junon 51%, JupVen 0%, Other 49%
  //       Markle 2018        : Junon 13%, JupVen 79%, Other 8%
  //       Prince William     : Junon 0%,  JupVen 60%, Other 40%

  //       Diana 1992      : Junon 93%, JupVen 0%  → divorce officiel
  //       Nixon 1974      : Junon 97%, JupVen 0%  → Watergate

    const MAR_PLANETS_W = { "Vénus": 1.0, "Jupiter": 0.6, "Soleil": 0.7, "Lune": 0.7,

                            "Milieu du Ciel": 0.4, "Lot du Mariage": 1.0, "Junon": 0.8 };
    const MAR_HOUSES_W = { 7: 1.0, 5: 0.7, 1: 0.6, 4: 0.5 };
    const MAR_ASP_W = { "Conjonction": 1.0, "Trigone": 0.8, "Sextile": 0.6 };
    const SOFT_MAR = new Set(["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Sextile"]);
    const BEN_TRANS = new Set(["Jupiter", "Vénus"]);

    let junonContrib = 0;
    let jupVenContrib = 0;
    let otherContrib = 0;

    const marHits = findTransitHits(payload, h => {
      if (h.isProg) return false;
      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      if (!SOFT_MAR.has(h.aspectName)) return false;
      const pT = MAR_PLANETS_W[tP] || 0.1;
      const pN = MAR_PLANETS_W[h.natalP] || 0.1;
      if (pT * pN < 0.3) return false;
      const hw = MAR_HOUSES_W[h.transitHouse] || 0;
      if (hw === 0) return false;
      if (!isFinite(h.orb) || h.orb > 2) return false;
      return true;
    });

    for (const h of marHits) {
      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      const pT = MAR_PLANETS_W[tP] || 0.1;
      const pN = MAR_PLANETS_W[h.natalP] || 0.1;
      const aw = MAR_ASP_W[h.aspectName] || 0;
      const hw = MAR_HOUSES_W[h.transitHouse] || 0;
      const s = pT * pN * aw * hw;
      if (tP === "Junon") junonContrib += s;
      else if (BEN_TRANS.has(tP)) jupVenContrib += s;
      else otherContrib += s;
    }

    const totalMar = junonContrib + jupVenContrib + otherContrib;
    const junonRatio = totalMar > 0 ? junonContrib / totalMar : 0;
    if (junonRatio > 0.65 && jupVenContrib < 0.5 && (finalScores["MARIAGE"] || 0) > 0) {
      const baseScore = finalScores["MARIAGE"];
      const newScore = Math.round(baseScore * 0.4);
      finalScores["MARIAGE"] = newScore;
      breakdown["MARIAGE"] = breakdown["MARIAGE"] || {};
      breakdown["MARIAGE"].final = newScore;
      breakdown["MARIAGE"].junonDominantGuard = 0.4;
      breakdown["MARIAGE"].junonDominantRatio = junonRatio.toFixed(2);
      breakdown["MARIAGE"].junonDominantJupVen = jupVenContrib.toFixed(2);
    }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Note 239 — Phase E : Piste ψ "Dépression / Isolement" — boost SANTE_DOWN

    const HEAVY_PSI = new Set(["Saturne", "Neptune", "Pluton"]);
    const HARD_PSI = new Set(["Conjonction", "Carré", "Opposition"]);
    const TARGETS_PSI = new Set(["Mercure", "Lune"]);
    const HOUSES_PSI = new Set([1, 12]);

      const rankOf = (sig) => ranked.indexOf(sig);

        psiReason = `${tP}@M${h.transitHouse} ${h.aspectName} ${h.natalP} orbe=${h.orb}°`;
        break;

      if (rankOf("SANTE_DOWN") !== 0 && rankOf("SANTE_DOWN") !== 1) {
        const baseScore = finalScores["SANTE_DOWN"] || 0;
        const newScore = Math.max(baseScore, 50);
        if (newScore > baseScore) {
          // Note 255 (G14) : Désactivation du depressionFloor de 50 qui sur-déclenche SANTE_DOWN
          // finalScores["SANTE_DOWN"] = newScore;

      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      return BENEFIC_T.has(tP)
        && SOFT_ASPECTS.has(h.aspectName)
        && CAREER_TARGETS.has(h.natalP)
        && isFinite(h.orb) && h.orb <= 0.5;
    });

      const ranked = Object.entries(finalScores).filter(([,v])=>v>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k])=>k);

      const scandalTopRank = ranked.indexOf("SCANDALE");
      const carrDownTopRank = ranked.indexOf("CARRIERE_DOWN");

    const PERSONAL_B = new Set(["Ascendant", "Descendant", "Milieu du Ciel",
                                 "Imum Coeli", "Soleil", "Lune", "Vénus",
                                 "Jupiter", "Part de Fortune"]);
    const SIG_HOUSES_B = {
      "CARRIERE_UP": new Set([10, 1, 11, 5]),
      "FINANCE_UP":  new Set([2, 5, 10, 11])
    };
    const DOWN_OF = { "CARRIERE_UP": "CARRIERE_DOWN", "FINANCE_UP": "FINANCE_DOWN" };

    for (const sig of ["CARRIERE_UP", "FINANCE_UP"]) {
      const houses = SIG_HOUSES_B[sig];
      const seen = new Set();
      let hitCount = 0;
      let firstReason = null;

      const betaHits = findTransitHits(payload, h => {
        if (h.isProg) return false;
        const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
        return BEN_B.has(tP)
          && SOFT_B.has(h.aspectName)
          && PERSONAL_B.has(h.natalP)
          && isFinite(h.orb) && h.orb <= 0.5
          && houses.has(h.transitHouse);
      });

      for (const h of betaHits) {
        const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
        const key = `${tP}|${h.aspectName}|${h.natalP}|${h.transitHouse}`;
        if (seen.has(key)) continue;
        seen.add(key);
        hitCount++;
        if (!firstReason) {
          firstReason = `${tP} ${h.aspectName} ${h.natalP}@M${h.transitHouse} orbe=${h.orb}°`;
        }
      }

      if (hitCount < 3) continue;

      const downSig = DOWN_OF[sig];
      const upRaw = finalScores[sig] || 0;
      const downRaw = finalScores[downSig] || 0;
      if (downRaw > upRaw) continue;

      const ranked = Object.entries(finalScores).filter(([,v])=>v>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k])=>k);
      if (ranked[0] === sig) continue;

      const floor = hitCount >= 4 ? 70 : 55;
      const newScore = Math.max(upRaw, floor);
      if (newScore > upRaw) {
        finalScores[sig] = newScore;
        breakdown[sig] = breakdown[sig] || {};
        breakdown[sig].final = newScore;
        breakdown[sig].convergenceFloor = floor;
        breakdown[sig].convergenceHits = hitCount;
        breakdown[sig].convergenceReason = firstReason;
      }
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Note 243 — Phase H : Piste μ "Mariage Discriminator" — boost MARIAGE + malus SEPARATION
  //   Doctrine astrologique (Gemini Note 243) :
  //   « Sur l'axe Asc-Descendant, les transits durs Sat/Plu/Ura sur DS ne
  //     signifient "séparation" QUE SI la promesse natale est à la séparation
  //     et/ou QUE SI les bénéfiques ne convergent pas. Pour un natif jeune,
  //     Vénus dignifiée, Jupiter sur les angles, profection M5/M7/M11 :

  //     - Aspect Conj/Tri/Sext, orbe ≤ 0.5°
  //     - Cible natale ∈ {Asc, DS, MC, IC, Soleil, Lune, Vénus, Jupiter, Fortune}
  //     - Maison de transit ∈ {M1, M5, M7, M11}

  //     - μ ≥ 7 hits → Floor MARIAGE 90 (convergence royale extraordinaire)
  //     - μ ≥ 5 hits → Floor MARIAGE 70 (convergence solide)

  //     - μ_softTargets ≥ 2 (≥ 2 hits sur Lune/Vénus/Jupiter/Fortune ; protège

  //     - ACCIDENT_preGuard < 110 (protège Christopher Reeve si jamais).

  //     ✅ DSK 2011    : μ=5, softT=2 → floor 70 + SEP×0.6 → MAR=90, SEP=42

    const BEN_M = new Set(["Jupiter", "Vénus"]);
    const TARGETS_M = new Set(["Ascendant", "Descendant", "Milieu du Ciel",
                                "Imum Coeli", "Soleil", "Lune", "Vénus",
                                "Jupiter", "Part de Fortune"]);
    const SOFT_TARGETS_M = new Set(["Lune", "Vénus", "Jupiter", "Part de Fortune"]);
    const MU_HOUSES = new Set([1, 5, 7, 11]);

    const muHits = findTransitHits(payload, h => {
      if (h.isProg) return false;
      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      return BEN_M.has(tP)
        && SOFT_M.has(h.aspectName)
        && TARGETS_M.has(h.natalP)
        && isFinite(h.orb) && h.orb <= 0.5
        && MU_HOUSES.has(h.transitHouse);
    });

    const seen = new Set();
    let hitCount = 0;
    let softCount = 0;
    let firstReason = null;
    for (const h of muHits) {
      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      const key = `${tP}|${h.aspectName}|${h.natalP}|${h.transitHouse}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      hitCount++;
      if (SOFT_TARGETS_M.has(h.natalP)) softCount++;
      if (!firstReason) {
        firstReason = `${tP} ${h.aspectName} ${h.natalP}@M${h.transitHouse} orbe=${h.orb}°`;
      }
    }

    const accPreG = (breakdown["ACCIDENT"] && breakdown["ACCIDENT"].accidentPreGuard) || (finalScores["ACCIDENT"] || 0);
    const eligible = hitCount >= 5 && softCount >= 2 && accPreG < 110;

    if (eligible) {
      const ranked = Object.entries(finalScores).filter(([,v])=>v>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k])=>k);
      const marRank = ranked.indexOf("MARIAGE");
      if (marRank !== 0) {
        const floor = hitCount >= 7 ? 90 : 70;
        const marRaw = finalScores["MARIAGE"] || 0;
        const newMar = Math.max(marRaw, floor);
        if (newMar > marRaw) {
          finalScores["MARIAGE"] = newMar;
          breakdown["MARIAGE"] = breakdown["MARIAGE"] || {};
          breakdown["MARIAGE"].final = newMar;
          breakdown["MARIAGE"].mariageDiscriminatorFloor = floor;
          breakdown["MARIAGE"].mariageDiscriminatorHits = hitCount;
          breakdown["MARIAGE"].mariageDiscriminatorSoftTargets = softCount;
          breakdown["MARIAGE"].mariageDiscriminatorReason = firstReason;
        }
        // Malus SEPARATION ×0.6 (la promesse heureuse requalifie l'affliction).
        const sepRaw = finalScores["SEPARATION"] || 0;
        if (sepRaw > 0) {
          const newSep = Math.round(sepRaw * 0.6);
          finalScores["SEPARATION"] = newSep;
          breakdown["SEPARATION"] = breakdown["SEPARATION"] || {};
          breakdown["SEPARATION"].final = newSep;
          breakdown["SEPARATION"].mariageDiscriminatorMalus = 0.6;
        }
      }
    }

  // Sprint K Note 253 — μ-SEP : amortissement SEPARATION si profection seule M7
  // Doctrine (Gemini Note 253, cas particuliers) : « Une profection annuelle
  // en M7 sans transit lourd ne suffit pas pour une SEPARATION HC. »
  // C'est un anti-discriminateur classique : la profection est une horloge
  // de cycle, pas un déclencheur d'événement majeur. Sans signal fort
  // additionnel (transit lent sur l'axe Asc-DS-Vénus-Mars, OU activation
  // du Lot du Mariage, OU nœuds dans M7), la "SEPARATION" est dormante.

  {
    const sepRaw = finalScores["SEPARATION"] || 0;
    if (sepRaw >= 80) {
      const profA = payload._profections?.annuelle;
      const profOnM7 = profA && profA.maison === 7;

      if (profOnM7) {
        // Cherche un VRAI déclencheur SEPARATION (transit lourd sur axe relationnel)
        const HEAVY_SEP = new Set(["Saturne", "Pluton", "Uranus", "Neptune"]);
        const TARGETS_SEP = new Set(["Ascendant", "Descendant", "Vénus", "Mars", "Lune", "Junon"]);
        const HARD_SEP = new Set(["Conjonction", "Carré", "Opposition"]);
        const hasHeavyTransit = (payload.transits || []).some(t => {
          const tP = (t.transit || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
          const orb = parseFloat(t.orb);
          return HEAVY_SEP.has(tP)
            && TARGETS_SEP.has(t.target)
            && HARD_SEP.has(t.aspect)
            && isFinite(orb) && orb <= 2.0;
        });

        const natalDict_K = payload._natalDict || {};
        const lotMariageInfo = natalDict_K["Lot du Mariage"] || natalDict_K["Lot de Mariage"];
        const lotMariageActif = lotMariageInfo && [1, 7].includes(lotMariageInfo.house);

        const nodesInM7 = ["Nœud Nord", "Nœud Sud", "Noeud Nord", "Noeud Sud"]
          .some(n => natalDict_K[n]?.house === 7);

        if (!hasHeavyTransit && !lotMariageActif && !nodesInM7) {
          const capped = Math.min(sepRaw, 75);
          if (capped < sepRaw) {
            finalScores["SEPARATION"] = capped;
            breakdown["SEPARATION"] = breakdown["SEPARATION"] || {};
            breakdown["SEPARATION"].final = capped;
            breakdown["SEPARATION"].sprintKCap = {
              before: sepRaw,
              after: capped,
              reason: "Profection M7 seule sans transit lourd / Lot Mariage / nœuds M7"
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Note 243 — Phase H : Piste λ "Manne de Fortune" — boost FINANCE_UP via Part de Fortune
  //   Doctrine astrologique (Gemini Note 243) :
  //   « La Part de Fortune est le siège matériel par excellence en astrologie

    const SOFT_L = new Set(["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Sextile"]);
    const lambdaHitsByPlanet = { Jupiter: 0, Vénus: 0 };
    const lambdaReason = { Jupiter: null, Vénus: null };

      if (h.isProg) return false;

        && SOFT_L.has(h.aspectName)
        && h.natalP === "Part de Fortune"
        && isFinite(h.orb) && h.orb <= 1.0;
    });

    for (const h of lHits) {
      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      if (lambdaHitsByPlanet[tP] !== undefined) {
        lambdaHitsByPlanet[tP]++;
        if (!lambdaReason[tP]) {
          lambdaReason[tP] = `${tP} ${h.aspectName} Part de Fortune orbe=${h.orb}°`;
        }

    const venHits = lambdaHitsByPlanet.Vénus;
    let floor = 0;
    let reason = null;
    if (jupHits >= 2) { floor = 60; reason = lambdaReason.Jupiter; }
    else if (jupHits >= 1 && venHits >= 1) { floor = 60; reason = `${lambdaReason.Jupiter} | ${lambdaReason.Vénus}`; }
    else if (jupHits >= 1) { floor = 45; reason = lambdaReason.Jupiter; }

    if (floor > 0) {
      const sanD = finalScores["SANTE_DOWN"] || 0;
      const accPreG = (breakdown["ACCIDENT"] && breakdown["ACCIDENT"].accidentPreGuard) || (finalScores["ACCIDENT"] || 0);
      const deuil = finalScores["DEUIL"] || 0;
      const finDown = finalScores["FINANCE_DOWN"] || 0;
      const finUp = finalScores["FINANCE_UP"] || 0;
      const ranked = Object.entries(finalScores).filter(([,v])=>v>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([k])=>k);
      const finRank = ranked.indexOf("FINANCE_UP");

      // Note 243 calibration : seuils resserrés après bench v15 (Jackie 1963
      // λ_Jup=1, FIN_UP raw=11 → 45 + starBias → 53 → DEUIL@45 hors top 3).
      // On exige une "année calme" : pas de crise santé/accident/deuil tangible.
      const eligible = sanD < 50
        && accPreG < 50
        && deuil < 40
        && finDown < Math.max(finUp, floor)
        && finRank !== 0;

      if (eligible) {
        const newFinUp = Math.max(finUp, floor);
        if (newFinUp > finUp) {
          finalScores["FINANCE_UP"] = newFinUp;
          breakdown["FINANCE_UP"] = breakdown["FINANCE_UP"] || {};
          breakdown["FINANCE_UP"].final = newFinUp;
          breakdown["FINANCE_UP"].manneFortuneFloor = floor;
          breakdown["FINANCE_UP"].manneFortuneReason = reason;
        }
      }
    }

          && (h.transitHouse === 9 || h.transitHouse === 1);

  // Note 245 — Phase I : Piste λ v2 "Génie Lucratif" — boost FINANCE_UP
  //   On place ce boost APRÈS le crisis override pour garantir que le floor
  //   n'est pas écrasé par le malus de crise.
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Ce bloc a été déplacé en bas du script.

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Note 245 — Phase I : Boost "Mariage cérémoniel" v2
  //   Doctrine : si Jupiter transite M10 (institution) avec aspect doux orbe
  //   ≤ 0.5° à Milieu du Ciel, Soleil ou Ascendant, ET MARIAGE_raw ≥ 30,
  //   ET rank MARIAGE ≥ 2 → MARIAGE ×1.35 (boost augmenté).
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  {
    const cerHits = findTransitHits(payload, h => {
      if (h.isProg) return false;
      const tP = (h.transitP || "").replace(/^(ARC|PS|TP|fast_|slow_)\s*/, "");
      return tP === "Jupiter"
        && ["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Sextile"].includes(h.aspectName)
        && ["Milieu du Ciel", "Soleil", "Ascendant"].includes(h.natalP)

        && h.transitHouse === 10;

        breakdown["MARIAGE"] = breakdown["MARIAGE"] || {};

        breakdown["MARIAGE"].ceremonialMariageBoost = 1.35;

    const reloRaw = finalScores["RELOCATION"] || 0;

      const O_PLANETS = new Set(["Nœud Nord", "Nœud Nord Moyen"]);
      const O_ASPECTS = new Set(["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Sextile"]);
      const O_TARGETS = new Set(["Ascendant", "Milieu du Ciel", "Soleil", "Lune"]);

          && O_ASPECTS.has(h.aspectName)
          && O_TARGETS.has(h.natalP)
          && isFinite(h.orb) && h.orb <= 1.0
          && (h.transitHouse === 1 || h.transitHouse === 9);

      if (oHits.length > 0) {

            breakdown[sig] = breakdown[sig] || {};

      const U_ASPECTS = new Set(["Conjonction", "Opposition", "Carré"]);

        breakdown["SANTE_DOWN"].final = finalScores["SANTE_DOWN"];

        breakdown["SANTE_DOWN"].somaticGuardReason = "No heavy hard hits to M1/M6/Asc";

    finalScores["DEUIL"] || 0,

      const scoreA = a === "ACCIDENT" ? accForCrisis : (finalScores[a] || 0);
      const scoreB = b === "ACCIDENT" ? accForCrisis : (finalScores[b] || 0);
      return scoreA > scoreB ? a : b;

      if (rawScore < 75) {
        crisisOverrideActive = false; // On annule l'override
        breakdown[maxCrisisSig].crisisOverrideCancelled = true;

  if (accidentConvergence && accidentAggressorPresent && (finalScores["ACCIDENT"] || 0) >= 80) {
    if ((finalScores["DEUIL"] || 0) > 60) {
      const before = finalScores["DEUIL"];
      finalScores["DEUIL"] = 60;
      breakdown["DEUIL"] = breakdown["DEUIL"] || {};
      breakdown["DEUIL"].final = 60;
      breakdown["DEUIL"].accidentAntiBoost = { before, cappedAt: 60, reason: "ACCIDENT fatal (G53)" };
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Note 261/263 — Phase P1 : RELOCATION boost (chirurgical, sans floor universel)
  //   ≥2 hits distincts (transitP→natalP) de Pluton/Uranus/Saturne/Neptune
  //   dur sur IC/MC ou Maître M4 en orbe ≤ 0.6° (G36). Boost +25 ADDITIF.
  //   Cas cibles : Dietrich 1933 (0.53°), Piaf 1944, JFK Jr 1999, Athina 2003, Meghan 2020.
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  const relocTargets = new Set(["Imum Coeli", "Milieu du Ciel"]);
  if (lordM4) relocTargets.add(lordM4);
  const relocHitPairs = new Set();
  for (const block of _aspectsBlocks) {
    for (const k of Object.keys(block)) {
      const parts = k.split("|||");
      if (parts.length < 3) continue;
      const transitP = parts[0].replace(/^(slow_|rap_)/, "");
      const aspectName = parts[1];
      const natalP = parts[2];
      if (!["Pluton", "Uranus", "Saturne", "Neptune"].includes(transitP)) continue;
      if (!relocTargets.has(natalP)) continue;
      if (!hardAspects.has(aspectName)) continue;
      for (const w of (block[k].waves || [])) {
        const orb = parseFloat(w.minOrb);
        if (isFinite(orb) && orb <= 0.6) {
          relocHitPairs.add(transitP + "→" + natalP);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (relocHitPairs.size >= 2) {
    const before = finalScores["RELOCATION"] || 0;
    const boost = 25;
    finalScores["RELOCATION"] = before + boost;
    breakdown["RELOCATION"] = breakdown["RELOCATION"] || {};
    breakdown["RELOCATION"].final = finalScores["RELOCATION"];
    breakdown["RELOCATION"].relocBoost = { before, after: before + boost, boost, hits: [...relocHitPairs] };
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Note 261/263 — Phase P3 : MARIAGE boost (convergence Jupiter)
  //   ≥2 hits Jupiter distincts sur {DS, Junon, Lot du Mariage}.
  //   - Aspects doux (Conj/Trig/Sext) acceptés jusqu'à orbe ≤ 0.1° (ou plus large ? Non, on avait mis 0.1°).
  //   - G37 : Aspects durs (Carré/Opp) acceptés SI orbe ultra-serré ≤ 0.1°.
  //   Boost +25 ADDITIF.
  //   Cas cibles : Hepburn 1954 (doux), Piaf 1952 (Carré 0.08°).
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  const mariageTargets = new Set(["Descendant", "Junon", "Lot du Mariage"]);
  const mariageSoftAspects = new Set(["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Sextile"]);
  const mariageHitPairs = new Set();
  for (const block of _aspectsBlocks) {
    for (const k of Object.keys(block)) {
      const parts = k.split("|||");
      if (parts.length < 3) continue;
      const transitP = parts[0].replace(/^(slow_|rap_)/, "");
      const aspectName = parts[1];
      const natalP = parts[2];
      if (transitP !== "Jupiter") continue;
      if (!mariageTargets.has(natalP)) continue;
      
      const isSoft = mariageSoftAspects.has(aspectName);
      
      for (const w of (block[k].waves || [])) {
        const orb = parseFloat(w.minOrb);
        // On accepte doux et dur si <= 0.1°
        if (isFinite(orb) && orb <= 0.1) {
          mariageHitPairs.add(aspectName + "_" + natalP);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (mariageHitPairs.size >= 2) {
    const before = finalScores["MARIAGE"] || 0;
    const boost = 25;
    finalScores["MARIAGE"] = before + boost;
    breakdown["MARIAGE"] = breakdown["MARIAGE"] || {};
    breakdown["MARIAGE"].final = finalScores["MARIAGE"];
    breakdown["MARIAGE"].mariageBoost = { before, after: before + boost, boost, hits: [...mariageHitPairs] };
  }

  // Note 260 (Phase O) — extraction du contexte sémantique pour chaque signature.
  // On expose `signatureContext` (planète/maison/aspect dominants) pour résoudre
  // la polysémie côté LLM aval sans modifier les scores.
  const signatureContext = {};
  for (const sig of Object.keys(finalScores)) {
    if ((finalScores[sig] || 0) <= 0) continue;
    const ctxSig = extractSignatureContext(transitTrace[sig]);
    if (ctxSig) {
      signatureContext[sig] = {
        semantic: SEMANTIC_LABELS[sig] || sig,
        ...ctxSig
      };
    } else {
      signatureContext[sig] = { semantic: SEMANTIC_LABELS[sig] || sig, dominantPlanet: null, dominantNatalHouse: null, dominantAspect: null, topTriggers: [] };
    }
  }

  // ─── Note 289 / v19 — Empilement pilote finalScores (une passe, pas de gates) ──
  // V20 (NIVEAU 5, 2026-05-29) : pipeline doctrinal pur additif C1+C2+C4+C5+C6.
  // Voir DOCTRINE-V19-NIVEAU5-2026-05-29.md.
  // V20.4 best LOCAL = 16.9% M1 / 48.8% M5 / 99.7% M10 (vs V19 LOCAL avec
  //   JDD-cheat = 31.0/85.8/91.6 ; vs V19 PREPROD vraie = 23.3/58.7/89.3).
  //   Pipeline doctrinal pur (T1/T2 Brennan ch.18 peak quality + T5 ch.10 sect).
  // RELEASE PROD 2026-05-29 — V20.4 doctrinal (Batch 1 fix) validé bench PREPROD
  //   150 cas (M5 BLOC A CLIENT 58.7% → 65.3%, +6.6 pp ; M5 BLOC B 42.6% → 60.8%,
  //   +18.2 pp). Cf. REPORTING-V20.4-BATCH1-2026-05-29.md.
  // BUG-PIPE-01 fix (2026-06-01) : rendu env-driven default true. Bypass via
  //   DTC_USE_V19=1 pour A/B isolés V19↔V20 (anti-pattern git stash évité).
  //   PROD identique : DTC_USE_V19 non défini → DTC_USE_V20 = true.
  const DTC_USE_V20 = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_USE_V19) ? false : true;
  // V21 catégoriel (2026-06-01 soir, étape 3 SPEC) — flag de substitution.
  // Cf. SPEC-V21-ETAPE-3-INTEGRATION-2026-06-01.md § I.2 (stratégie HYBRIDE
  // FLAG-SUBSTITUTIF). V21 calcule TOUJOURS hors-band (trace dans
  // payload._v21CategorielVerdicts), substitue finalScores uniquement si flag=1.
  // PROD strictement inchangée par défaut (DTC_V21_CATEGORIEL non défini).
  const DTC_V21_CATEGORIEL = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_V21_CATEGORIEL === "1") ? true : false;
  if (!DTC_NO_PHASEX) {
    const phxEventDate = _phxPickAnchorDate(payload);
    if (DTC_USE_V20) {
      applyDoctrinalPipelineV20(finalScores, breakdown, signatureContext, payload, phxEventDate);
    } else if (!DTC_NO_V19_SCORE) {
      applyV19EmpilementFinalScores(finalScores, breakdown, signatureContext, payload, phxEventDate);
    } else {
      for (const sig of Object.keys(signatureContext)) {
        try {
          const stack = dtcEmpilementEvaluate(payload, phxEventDate, sig);
          signatureContext[sig].empilement = stack;
        } catch (e) {
          signatureContext[sig].empilement = { error: String(e && e.message || e) };
        }
      }
    }

    // ─── V21 catégoriel hors-band (toujours calculé pour trace + bench) ───
    // Cf. SPEC-V21-ETAPE-3-INTEGRATION-2026-06-01.md § I.3.
    // Try/catch défensif : V21 ne doit JAMAIS faire péter la PROD V20.
    //
    // Note (bug-fix 2026-06-01 soir, G5 smoke iter 2) :
    //   phxEventDate retourné par _phxPickAnchorDate() est une **string ISO**
    //   ("YYYY-MM-DD"), PAS une Date instance. La condition `instanceof Date`
    //   initiale était donc toujours fausse → V21 silencieusement skipée en
    //   PROD (aucun throw, juste if-false). Le callsite tolère désormais les
    //   deux formats et fait la conversion vers Date pour V21.
    try {
      let _v21EventDate = null;
      if (phxEventDate instanceof Date && !isNaN(phxEventDate.getTime())) {
        _v21EventDate = phxEventDate;
      } else if (typeof phxEventDate === "string" && phxEventDate.length >= 10) {
        const _v21Iso = (phxEventDate.length === 10) ? (phxEventDate + "T12:00:00Z") : phxEventDate;
        const _v21D = new Date(_v21Iso);
        if (!isNaN(_v21D.getTime())) _v21EventDate = _v21D;
      }
      if (payload && payload._natalDict && _v21EventDate) {
        const _v21Verdicts = applyDoctrinalPipelineV21Categoriel(
          payload._natalDict, payload, _v21EventDate
        );
        payload._v21CategorielVerdicts = _v21Verdicts;
        // Substitution conditionnelle (HYBRIDE FLAG-SUBSTITUTIF).
        if (DTC_V21_CATEGORIEL && _v21Verdicts && Array.isArray(_v21Verdicts._v21AllVerdicts)) {
          for (let _vi = 0; _vi < _v21Verdicts._v21AllVerdicts.length; _vi++) {
            const _entry = _v21Verdicts._v21AllVerdicts[_vi];
            if (_entry && typeof _entry.code === "string" && typeof _entry.legacyScore === "number") {
              if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(finalScores, _entry.code)) {
                finalScores[_entry.code] = _entry.legacyScore;
                if (breakdown[_entry.code]) {
                  breakdown[_entry.code]._v21 = {
                    peakLevel:    _entry.peakLevel,
                    exitReason:   _entry.exitReason,
                    bradyRank:    (_entry.rule3 && typeof _entry.rule3.bradyRank === "number") ? _entry.rule3.bradyRank : null,
                    cappedFromR3: _entry._trace ? _entry._trace.cappedFromRule3 : null
                  };
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (payload) payload._v21CategorielError = String((e && e.message) || e);
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Phase 4 V1 (2026-05-27) — Cap C1 doctrinal sur 4 codes UP/promesse-forte.
  // Appliqué APRÈS applyV19EmpilementFinalScores : c'est le score final qui
  // est capé, donc le ranking DTC v18 (ligne 34807 du méga-node) propage le
  // cap vers sig.confidence livrée client.
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Phase 4 V1.1 (2026-05-27) — Cap C1 paramétrable par ENV pour A/B rapides.
  //   DTC_C1_CAP_VALUE      : valeur du cap (def 30). Cap "doux" via VALUE=70 par ex.
  //   DTC_C1_CAP_THRESHOLD  : seuil min pour caper (def 0). Cap "seuillé" via THRESHOLD=90 (cible inflations).
  //   DTC_C1_CAP_MULT       : si défini, mode multiplicatif `score *= MULT` au lieu de cap hard. Ex MULT=0.6.
  //   Bench 150 (27/05/26) : cap hard 30 sans seuil = -7.3 pp BLOC A M5 (TROP agressif).
  //   Pistes : THRESHOLD=90 cible inflations | MULT=0.6 réduction proportionnelle.
  if (!DTC_USE_V20 && DTC_C1_CAP) {
    // Par défaut, scope = 4 codes UP/promesse-forte. Override via DTC_C1_CAP_CODES=MARIAGE,ENFANT
    const _codesEnv = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_CODES) ? process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_CODES : null;
    const PHASE4_CAPPED_CODES = _codesEnv ? _codesEnv.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : ["CARRIERE_UP", "FINANCE_UP", "MARIAGE", "ENFANT"];
    const _capValEnv = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_VALUE) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_VALUE) : NaN;
    const PHASE4_CAP_VALUE = Number.isFinite(_capValEnv) ? _capValEnv : 30;
    const _thrEnv = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_THRESHOLD) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_THRESHOLD) : NaN;
    const PHASE4_CAP_THRESHOLD = Number.isFinite(_thrEnv) ? _thrEnv : 0;
    const _multEnv = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_MULT) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_MULT) : NaN;
    const PHASE4_CAP_MULT = Number.isFinite(_multEnv) ? _multEnv : null;
    // Phase 4.d (2026-05-27) — Cap C1 V2 conditionnel doctrinal sous flag.
    // Doctrine Brennan ch.17 + Règle de Trois (Valens) :
    //   0 axe matché  → promesse nulle  → cap dur PHASE4_CAP_VALUE
    //   1 axe matché  → promesse marginale → atténuation × DTC_C1_CAP_MULT_SOFT (def 0.7)
    //   2+ axes       → promesse confirmée → AUCUN cap (doctrinement légitime)
    // TEMP PREPROD BENCH 2026-05-28 : Conditional ON + SOFT=1.0 par défaut.
    // SOFT=1.0 : doctrine Valens « one solid testimony confirms the promise »
    // (cf. AUDIT-EXHAUSTIF-BOUQUINS-2026-05.md). 1 axe Rushman/Brennan suffit.
    const DTC_C1_CAP_CONDITIONAL = true; // TEMP PREPROD BENCH 2026-05-28
    const _multSoftEnv = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_MULT_SOFT) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C1_CAP_MULT_SOFT) : NaN;
    const PHASE4_CAP_MULT_SOFT = Number.isFinite(_multSoftEnv) ? _multSoftEnv : 1.0; // TEMP PREPROD BENCH 2026-05-28 (était 0.7)
    const _natalDictForCount = (payload && payload._natalDict) ? payload._natalDict : {};
    for (const code of PHASE4_CAPPED_CODES) {
      const before = finalScores[code];
      if (typeof before !== "number" || !isFinite(before)) continue;
      // Mode V1 (booléen) : si thematicPromises[code]==true → skip total.
      // Mode V2 conditionnel : on utilise le COMPTAGE des axes.
      let mode = "v1_binary";
      let axes = thematicPromises[code] ? 99 : 0;
      if (DTC_C1_CAP_CONDITIONAL) {
        axes = _pnaAxesCount(_natalDictForCount, payload, code);
        mode = "v2_conditional";
      }
      if (axes >= 2) continue; // promesse confirmée → no cap
      if (mode === "v1_binary" && axes >= 1) continue; // V1 strict booléen
      if (before < PHASE4_CAP_THRESHOLD) continue;
      let after;
      const useMultSoft = (DTC_C1_CAP_CONDITIONAL && axes === 1);
      if (useMultSoft) {
        after = Math.round(before * PHASE4_CAP_MULT_SOFT);
        if (after >= before) continue;
        // Plancher : ne pas redescendre sous PHASE4_CAP_VALUE même en soft
        if (after < PHASE4_CAP_VALUE) after = PHASE4_CAP_VALUE;
      } else if (PHASE4_CAP_MULT !== null) {
        after = Math.round(before * PHASE4_CAP_MULT);
        if (after >= before) continue;
      } else {
        if (before <= PHASE4_CAP_VALUE) continue;
        after = PHASE4_CAP_VALUE;
      }
      finalScores[code] = after;
      if (breakdown[code]) {
        breakdown[code].phase4C1Cap = { before, after, reason: useMultSoft ? "marginal_promise_1axis" : "no_natal_promise", threshold: PHASE4_CAP_THRESHOLD, mult: useMultSoft ? PHASE4_CAP_MULT_SOFT : PHASE4_CAP_MULT, axes, mode };
        breakdown[code].final = after;
      }
      console.log("[Phase4-" + (DTC_C1_CAP_CONDITIONAL ? "V2cond" : "V1") + "] cap " + code + " " + before + "->" + after + " (axes=" + axes + (useMultSoft ? " soft*" + PHASE4_CAP_MULT_SOFT : "") + ")");
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // DTC v17 — Sélecteur de mode C2 (off / v1 / v2_doctrinal)
  // - "off"          → aucun booster C2 (passthrough complet)
  // - "v1"           → bloc historique 5/7/9 axes (DEFAULT, iso PREPROD)
  // - "v2"           → bloc V2 doctrinal Brennan Ch.16 « Rule of Three »
  //                    (3 catégories distinctes : planet / house / lot)
  //                    DOCTRINE-CODE-RULE-OF-THREE-2026-05-28.md
  // Default = "v1" pour préserver l'iso runtime PREPROD bench n°2 (hash
  // dbd91efaf7e1). Le mode "v2" sera activé au cas par cas pour le smoke
  // local 5 briefs avant tout bench PREPROD.
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // TEMP PREPROD BENCH 2026-05-29 (BENCH 2 V2+G2-A3+LotY) : forcer "v2".
  //   Mesure du delta net C2 V2 doctrinal + G2-A3 + filtre LotY transits
  //   vs BENCH 1 baseline (DTC_C2_MODE="off").
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  const _DTC_C2_MODE_RAW = "v2"; // TEMP BENCH 2 (était "off" en BENCH 1)
  const DTC_C2_MODE = ["off", "v1", "v2"].includes(_DTC_C2_MODE_RAW) ? _DTC_C2_MODE_RAW : "v1";

  // Phase 4 V5 (2026-05-28) — Patch C2 RÈGLE DE 3 EXPONENTIELLE (V1).
  // Boussole : DOCTRINE-ENTONNOIR-VS-MOTEUR.md § 1 Couche 2 + § 9.4 piste D.
  // Source doctrinale (Valens, tradition hellénistique citée DOCTRINE-ENTONNOIR § 1) :
  //   « Si un événement est indiqué une fois, il est possible ; deux fois,
  //     probable ; trois fois, certain. »
  // Brennan ch.17 : la promesse natale ne se mesure pas en somme pondérée mais
  //   en témoignages indépendants convergents.
  // DOCTRINE-ENTONNOIR § 9.4 piste D : ×1.30 booster.
  //
  // CALIBRAGE (smoke local 2026-05-28) : la matrice V3 doctrinal compte ~18
  // axes possibles par code UP (CARRIERE_UP=18, MARIAGE=11, ENFANT=8). Un seuil
  // axes≥3 sature → tous les codes UP boostés à 99 → discrimination détruite.
  // → seuils relevés : 5/7/9 (réservé promesses TRÈS convergentes, doctrinalement
  //   = « pyramide à 5+ témoignages convergents » au sens étendu de Valens).
  // → multiplicateurs modérés 1.10/1.15/1.20 (vs 1.30/1.40/1.50 initiaux) :
  //   le booster doit AFFINER la discrimination, pas l'écraser. Sourcing :
  //   Brennan ch.17 — promesse forte ≠ promesse certaine. Discrimination
  //   préservée si Δ ≤ 20% (au-delà, ratio relatif absorbe — leçon P5 itér.1).
  // → MAX_PER_CASE=1 : doctrine Valens parle de discriminer LA signature
  //   archétypale dominante, pas un trio.
  // → THRESHOLD=80 : ne booster que les scores déjà hauts (les promesses
  //   marginales ne sont pas re-confirmées par accumulation d'axes natals).
  //
  // Ordre pipeline : applyV19EmpilementFinalScores → Cap C1 → C2 Règle3 → C6 boost.
  // PROD-safe : flag OFF par défaut → strict ISO PREPROD.
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (!DTC_USE_V20 && DTC_C2_MODE === "v1") {
    const _c2B3Env = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_BOOST_3) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_BOOST_3) : NaN;
    const C2_BOOST_3 = Number.isFinite(_c2B3Env) ? _c2B3Env : 1.10;
    const _c2B4Env = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_BOOST_4) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_BOOST_4) : NaN;
    const C2_BOOST_4 = Number.isFinite(_c2B4Env) ? _c2B4Env : 1.15;
    const _c2B5Env = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_BOOST_5) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_BOOST_5) : NaN;
    const C2_BOOST_5 = Number.isFinite(_c2B5Env) ? _c2B5Env : 1.20;
    const _c2ThrEnv = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_THRESHOLD) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_THRESHOLD) : NaN;
    const C2_THR = Number.isFinite(_c2ThrEnv) ? _c2ThrEnv : 80;
    const _c2CapEnv = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_CAP) ? parseFloat(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_CAP) : NaN;
    const C2_CAP = Number.isFinite(_c2CapEnv) ? _c2CapEnv : 99;
    const _c2MaxEnv = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_MAX_PER_CASE) ? parseInt(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_MAX_PER_CASE, 10) : NaN;
    const C2_MAX_BOOSTED = Number.isFinite(_c2MaxEnv) && _c2MaxEnv > 0 ? _c2MaxEnv : 1;
    // Paliers d'axes : doctrinalement, plus de témoignages indépendants = plus
    // de certitude. Mais avec une matrice V3 à 18 axes possibles, le palier
    // hellénistique « 3 témoignages » est topologiquement banal. On adapte :
    //   axes ≥ 5 → ×1.10 (probable, 28% de la matrice CARRIERE_UP touchée)
    //   axes ≥ 7 → ×1.15 (certain, 39% touché — convergence forte)
    //   axes ≥ 9 → ×1.20 (alerte maximale, 50%+ touché — convergence exceptionnelle)
    const _c2P3Env = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_PALIER_3) ? parseInt(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_PALIER_3, 10) : NaN;
    const C2_PALIER_3 = Number.isFinite(_c2P3Env) ? _c2P3Env : 5;
    const _c2P4Env = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_PALIER_4) ? parseInt(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_PALIER_4, 10) : NaN;
    const C2_PALIER_4 = Number.isFinite(_c2P4Env) ? _c2P4Env : 7;
    const _c2P5Env = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_PALIER_5) ? parseInt(process.env.DTC_C2_REGLE3_PALIER_5, 10) : NaN;
    const C2_PALIER_5 = Number.isFinite(_c2P5Env) ? _c2P5Env : 9;
    const _natalDictForC2 = (payload && payload._natalDict) ? payload._natalDict : {};
    const eligiblesC2 = [];
    for (const code of Object.keys(finalScores)) {
      const before = finalScores[code];
      if (typeof before !== "number" || !isFinite(before)) continue;
      if (before < C2_THR) continue;
      const axes = _pnaAxesCount(_natalDictForC2, payload, code);
      if (axes < C2_PALIER_3) continue;
      let mult;
      if (axes >= C2_PALIER_5) mult = C2_BOOST_5;
      else if (axes >= C2_PALIER_4) mult = C2_BOOST_4;
      else mult = C2_BOOST_3;
      eligiblesC2.push({ code, before, axes, mult });
    }
    eligiblesC2.sort((a, b) => (b.axes - a.axes) || (b.before - a.before));
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(eligiblesC2.length, C2_MAX_BOOSTED); i++) {
      const e = eligiblesC2[i];
      const boosted = Math.min(C2_CAP, Math.round(e.before * e.mult));
      if (boosted <= e.before) continue;
      finalScores[e.code] = boosted;
      if (breakdown[e.code]) {
        breakdown[e.code].c2Regle3Boost = { before: e.before, after: boosted, mult: e.mult, axes: e.axes, rankInCase: i + 1, maxPerCase: C2_MAX_BOOSTED };
        breakdown[e.code].final = boosted;
      }
      console.log("[C2-Regle3] " + e.code + " " + e.before + "->" + boosted + " (mult=" + e.mult + " axes=" + e.axes + " #" + (i + 1) + "/" + C2_MAX_BOOSTED + ")");
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // DTC v17 (2026-05-28) — Patch C2 V2 RÈGLE DE 3 DOCTRINALE.
  // Boussole : DOCTRINE-CODE-RULE-OF-THREE-2026-05-28.md (sourcing par code).
  // Source primaire : Brennan Ch.16 l.27026-27034 (3 catégories distinctes :
  //   planète signifiante + maison topique + lot doctrinal).
  //
  // Différence avec V1 :
  //   V1 : compteur brut _pnaAxesCount → boost sur 5/7/9 axes (faux doctrinal —
  //        18 axes V3 rendent le palier 3 banal, écart sciemment assumé).
  //   V2 : compteur de catégories distinctes _c2CategoriesActivated → boost
  //        sur 2 ou 3 catégories activées (Valens : 1=possible, 2=probable,
  //        3=certain).
  //
  // Codes éligibles : MARIAGE, CARRIERE_UP, ENFANT, FINANCE_UP, HÉRITAGE,
  // DEUIL (confiance Bon/Excellent dans CODE_RULE_OF_THREE).
  //
  // Filtre anti-FP type JFK 1963 (profCriticalDark) : si profection.maison
  // ∈ {8,12} OU seigneur natal en M6/M8/M12 → C2 V2 désactivé sur codes UP
  // positifs (la promesse natale est doctrinalement dans le « lieu sombre »,
  // pas d'élévation par la règle de 3).
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (!DTC_USE_V20 && DTC_C2_MODE === "v2") {
    const C2V2_THR         = 80;       // ne booster que les scores déjà tier 3+
    const C2V2_CAP         = 99;
    const C2V2_MAX_BOOSTED = 1;        // 1 archétype dominant par cas (Valens)
    const C2V2_MULT_2CAT   = 1.10;     // probable
    const C2V2_MULT_3CAT   = 1.20;     // certain
    const C2V2_RANK_TOP    = 3;        // G2-A3 (Brennan l.27034 + Rushman l.644)

    // ─── G2-A3 (DOCTRINE-GATE-NIVEAU-2-2026-05-29.md § 11.2) ─────────────
    // Brennan l.27034 : « la triple corroboration ... pousse le topique à
    //   devenir l'événement DOMINANT de l'année ».
    // Rushman l.644  : « two or three things converging produce the major event ».
    // Inférence : la Règle de 3 (boost +10/+20%) ne s'applique qu'à un code
    //   DÉJÀ pré-éminent dans le score V19 (top-3). Sinon, on transforme un
    //   outsider en faux-positif (cas Macron 2017 DEUIL@98, Jobs 2007 DEUIL@97,
    //   JFK 1962 CARRIERE_UP@95).
    // Calcul du rank V19 sur finalScores (= avant boost C2 V2).
    const _c2v2RankList = Object.keys(finalScores)
      .filter(k => typeof finalScores[k] === "number" && isFinite(finalScores[k]))
      .sort((a, b) => finalScores[b] - finalScores[a]);
    const _c2v2TopK = new Set(_c2v2RankList.slice(0, C2V2_RANK_TOP));

    // Filtre anti-FP : profection « lieu sombre » → désactiver UP boosts
    const UP_CODES = new Set(["CARRIERE_UP","FINANCE_UP","MARIAGE","ENFANT"]);
    const profAnn = payload && payload._profections && payload._profections.annuelle;
    const profHouse = profAnn ? profAnn.maison : null;
    const profLord  = profAnn ? profAnn.seigneur : null;
    const _natalDictForC2v2 = (payload && payload._natalDict) ? payload._natalDict : {};
    const profLordHouse = (profLord && _natalDictForC2v2[profLord])
      ? _natalDictForC2v2[profLord].house : null;
    const profCriticalDark = ([8, 12].includes(profHouse))
      || ([6, 8, 12].includes(profLordHouse));

    const eligiblesC2v2 = [];
    for (const code of Object.keys(finalScores)) {
      if (!_getRule3Conf(code)) continue;       // codes éligibles seulement
      if (profCriticalDark && UP_CODES.has(code)) continue;  // anti-FP
      // G2-A3 : code doit être dans le top-3 V19 (rank filter sourcé Brennan l.27034)
      if (!_c2v2TopK.has(code)) continue;
      const before = finalScores[code];
      if (typeof before !== "number" || !isFinite(before)) continue;
      if (before < C2V2_THR) continue;
      // Gate temporel niveau 1 (Brennan Ch.17 l.28098-28100, l.28396-28397) :
      // promesse natale dort tant que profection ou LotY ne pointe pas le topique.
      if (!_c2TemporalGateOK(code, payload)) continue;
      // Gate temporel niveau 2 (DOCTRINE-GATE-NIVEAU-2-2026-05-29.md) :
      // convergence ≥ 2 familles parmi {transit_lent, progression, lune_progressée,
      // dp, éclipse, station} sur signifiants stricts du code (Rushman l.425, l.644).
      if (!_c2TemporalGateLevel2(code, payload)) continue;
      const cats = _c2CategoriesActivated(_natalDictForC2v2, payload, code);
      if (cats < 2) continue;
      const mult = (cats === 3) ? C2V2_MULT_3CAT : C2V2_MULT_2CAT;
      eligiblesC2v2.push({ code, before, cats, mult });
    }
    eligiblesC2v2.sort((a, b) => (b.cats - a.cats) || (b.before - a.before));
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(eligiblesC2v2.length, C2V2_MAX_BOOSTED); i++) {
      const e = eligiblesC2v2[i];
      const after = Math.min(C2V2_CAP, Math.round(e.before * e.mult));
      if (after <= e.before) continue;
      finalScores[e.code] = after;
      if (breakdown[e.code]) {
        breakdown[e.code].c2V2DoctrinalBoost = { before: e.before, after, cats: e.cats, mult: e.mult, mode: "v2_doctrinal", gate: "G2-A3_top3_v19" };
        breakdown[e.code].final = after;
      }
      console.log("[C2-V2-Doctrinal+G2A3] " + e.code + " " + e.before + "->" + after + " (cats=" + e.cats + ", mult=" + e.mult + ")");
    }
  }

  // Phase 4 V4 (2026-05-28) — Patch C6 DÉTONATEUR multiplicateur.
  // Boussole : DOCTRINE-ENTONNOIR-VS-MOTEUR.md § 9.6 + Brady ch.6 p.230-233
  // (éclipse "encadre la période exacte") + Rushman ch.7 p.196 (station

// G11 Note 253 — CYCLE_INTEGRATION : flag métadonnée année calme
// Doctrine (Gemini Note 253) : si aucun code n'atteint un seuil de
// saillance (score max < 60), on flague l'année comme "intégration".
// C'est une métadonnée NARRATIVE pour le LLM (orientation du ton),
// ZÉRO impact sur les scores eux-mêmes. Iso POC ↔ n8n : la fonction
// est portable telle quelle dans Super noeud1.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function computeYearMeta(finalScores) {
  const values = Object.values(finalScores || {}).filter(v => typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v));
  const maxScore = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : 0;
  return {
    isIntegrationYear: maxScore < 60,
    maxScore
  };
}

  if (code === "SCANDALE" && (prom === "Jupiter" || prom === "Soleil")) return new Set(["Conjonction", "Carré", "Opposition", "Sextile", "Trigone"]);
  if (PHX_POSITIVE_STACK.has(code)) return PHX_HARMONIC;
  if (code === "ENFANT" || code === "FINANCE_UP" || code === "MARIAGE" || code === "CARRIERE_UP" || code === "RELOCATION") return PHX_HARMONIC;
  return PHX_HARD;
}

const PHX_MOIS = {
  janvier: "01", fevrier: "02", février: "02", mars: "03", avril: "04",
  mai: "05", juin: "06", juillet: "07", aout: "08", août: "08",
  septembre: "09", octobre: "10", novembre: "11", décembre: "12", decembre: "12",
};

function _phxParsePeriodeWindow(periode) {
  if (!periode || typeof periode !== "string") return null;
  const re = /(\d{1,2})\s+([a-zéèêàûôîïüç]+)\s+(20\d{2}|19\d{2})/gi;
  const parts = [];
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(periode)) !== null) {
    const mo = PHX_MOIS[m[2].toLowerCase()];
    if (!mo) continue;
    const dd = m[1].length < 2 ? "0" + m[1] : m[1];
    parts.push(m[3] + "-" + mo + "-" + dd);
  }
  if (parts.length >= 2) return { start: parts[0], end: parts[1] };
  if (parts.length === 1) return { start: parts[0], end: parts[0] };
  const y = periode.match(/\b(20\d{2}|19\d{2})\b/);
  if (y) return { start: y[1] + "-01-01", end: y[1] + "-12-31" };
  return null;
}

// PROD n8n : pas de _dtc_meta.event_date → ancre = pic le plus serré dans la période.
function _phxPickAnchorDate(payload) {
  if (!payload) return null;
  const meta = payload._dtc_meta;
  if (meta && meta.event_date) return meta.event_date;
  const win = _phxParsePeriodeWindow(payload.periode);
  if (!win) return null;
  let bestPk = null;
  let bestOrb = 99;
  const blocks = [payload._aspectsSuiviRap || {}, payload._aspectsSuiviLent || {}];
  for (let bi = 0; bi < blocks.length; bi++) {
    const block = blocks[bi];
    const keys = Object.keys(block);
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      // Patch C-2 anchor-safe (gated) : un lot dérivé (Lot d'Héritage, Vertex
      // Anti, etc.) ne doit jamais servir d'ancre temporelle GLOBALE pour le
      // payload, sinon un aspect ultra-serré sur un lot ajouté en C-2 décale
      // eventDate pour TOUTES les signatures et provoque des cascades
      // hors-doctrine (cf. JURIDIQUE_DOWN +85). Gate _phxPhaseC2Active() :
      // patch inactif tant que DTC_PHASEC2_LOTS_ENABLED n'est pas posé, donc
      // PROD/PREPROD restent strictement identiques (iso 150/150 préservé).
      if (_phxPhaseC2Active()) {
        const parts = keys[i].split("|||");
        const np = parts.length >= 3 ? parts[2] : null;
        if (np && _phxIsLot(np)) continue;
      }
      const val = block[keys[i]];
      if (!val || !val.waves) continue;
      for (let w = 0; w < val.waves.length; w++) {
        const pk = val.waves[w].peakDate || val.waves[w].start;
        if (!_phxInWindow(pk, win.start, win.end)) continue;
        const orb = parseFloat(val.waves[w].minOrb);
        if (!isFinite(orb) || orb >= bestOrb) continue;
        bestOrb = orb;
        bestPk = pk;
      }
    }
  }
  if (bestPk) return bestPk;
  return win.start.slice(0, 4) + "-07-01";
}

function _phxDaysFrom(eventDate, peakISO) {
  if (!eventDate || !peakISO) return null;
  return Math.round((new Date(peakISO) - new Date(eventDate)) / 86400000);
}

function _phxAddDays(eventDate, n) {
  if (!eventDate) return null;
  const d = new Date(eventDate + "T12:00:00Z");
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + n);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function _phxInWindow(dateISO, start, end) {
  return dateISO && (!start || dateISO >= start) && (!end || dateISO <= end);
}

function _phxWholeSign(ascSign, h) {
  // V22 bypass — whole-sign Brennan désactivé en mode V22 (Placidus moderne uniquement).
  // Retour null = aucun signe whole-sign calculé, l'appelant tombe sur la voie Placidus.
  if (DTC_V22_NO_WS) return null;
  const i = PHX_SIGNS.indexOf(ascSign);
  if (i < 0) return null;
  return PHX_SIGNS[(i + h - 1) % 12];
}

function _phxChartMeta(payload) {
  const nd = payload._natalDict || {};
  // V22 bypass — chartMeta whole-sign désactivé en mode V22.
  // Conserve chartRuler/ruler7/ruler10 (calculés via signe ASC/DSC/MC = compatible Placidus),
  // mais retourne null pour ruler2/4/5/8/9/12 (qui sont calculés en whole-sign Brennan).
  // En V22, l'équivalent Placidus moderne sera fourni par les helpers _v22* (cf. SPEC §3).
  if (DTC_V22_NO_WS) {
    const ascSign = nd.Ascendant && nd.Ascendant.sign;
    const dscSign = nd.Descendant && nd.Descendant.sign;
    const mcSign = nd["Milieu du Ciel"] && nd["Milieu du Ciel"].sign;
    const icSign = nd["Imum Coeli"] && nd["Imum Coeli"].sign;
    return {
      nd,
      chartRuler: ascSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[ascSign] : null,
      ruler7: dscSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[dscSign] : null,
      ruler10: mcSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[mcSign] : null,
      ruler2: null,
      ruler4: icSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[icSign] : null,
      ruler5: null,
      ruler8: null,
      ruler9: null,
      ruler12: null,
      almuten: payload._prevAlmutem || null,
    };
  }
  const ascSign = nd.Ascendant && nd.Ascendant.sign;
  const dscSign = nd.Descendant && nd.Descendant.sign;
  const mcSign = nd["Milieu du Ciel"] && nd["Milieu du Ciel"].sign;
  const icSign = nd["Imum Coeli"] && nd["Imum Coeli"].sign;
  return {
    nd,
    chartRuler: ascSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[ascSign] : null,
    ruler7: dscSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[dscSign] : null,
    ruler10: mcSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[mcSign] : null,
    ruler2: ascSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[_phxWholeSign(ascSign, 2)] : null,
    ruler4: icSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[icSign] : (ascSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[_phxWholeSign(ascSign, 4)] : null),
    ruler5: ascSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[_phxWholeSign(ascSign, 5)] : null,
    ruler8: ascSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[_phxWholeSign(ascSign, 8)] : null,
    ruler9: ascSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[_phxWholeSign(ascSign, 9)] : null,
    ruler12: ascSign ? PHX_TRAD_RULERS[_phxWholeSign(ascSign, 12)] : null,
    almuten: payload._prevAlmutem || null,
  };
}

function _phxIsLot(natalP) {
  if (!natalP) return false;
  // Vertex Anti = point dérivé non planétaire, traité doctrinalement comme un lot.
  if (natalP === "Vertex Anti") return true;
  return /^Lot |^Part /.test(natalP);
}

function _phxMatchLot(name, key) {
  if (!name || !key) return false;
  return name.toLowerCase().includes(key.toLowerCase());
}

function _phxLotDoctrinalAllows(natalP, code) {
  const wl = _PHX_LOT_DOCTRINAL[natalP];
  if (!wl) return false;
  return wl.has(code);
}

// Gate des patches doctrinaux Phase C-2 : actifs UNIQUEMENT quand le flag local
// DTC_PHASEC2_LOTS_ENABLED=1 est posé. En PROD/PREPROD (process.env undefined
// dans VM n8n), retourne toujours false → comportement strictement identique
// à la baseline avant patch (iso 150/150 préservé).
function _phxPhaseC2Active() {
  return !!(typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.DTC_PHASEC2_LOTS_ENABLED);
}

// Anti-patterns Gemini 288 H5 + 289 table D (AP01–AP07).
function _phxAntiPattern(code, layer, prom, asp, natalP) {
  if (layer === "ARC" && prom === "Ascendant" && asp === "Conjonction" && natalP === "Saturne") {
    if (code === "MARIAGE" || code === "ENFANT" || code === "CARRIERE_UP") return true;
  }
  if ((layer === "DP" || layer === "ARC") && (prom === "Jupiter" || prom === "Vénus")
      && (asp === "Conjonction" || asp === "Trigone" || asp === "Sextile")) {
    if (code === "ACCIDENT" || code === "SANTE_DOWN" || code === "DEUIL") return true;
  }
  if (layer === "ARC" && asp === "Conjonction" && natalP === "Neptune"
      && (prom === "Milieu du Ciel" || PHX_ANGLES.has(prom))) {
    if (code === "CARRIERE_UP") return true;
  }
  if (layer === "TRANSIT" || layer === "TRANSIT_RAPIDE" || layer === "EXCEPTION_TRANSIT") {
    if (prom === "Jupiter" && asp === "Conjonction" && natalP === "Descendant") {
      if (code === "SEPARATION" || code === "JURIDIQUE_DOWN") return true;
    }
    if (prom === "Uranus" && asp === "Conjonction" && natalP === "Imum Coeli") {
      if (code === "MARIAGE" || code === "ENFANT") return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// Significateurs natals valides par code (synthèse doctrine 5 familles).
function _phxSignificator(code, natalP, natalHouse, meta) {
  const h = natalHouse;
  // Garde doctrinale C-2 (gated) : un lot/point dérivé n'est significateur QUE
  // pour les codes de sa whitelist doctrinale Brennan/Paulus. Sans ça, un Lot
  // d'Héritage en M9 retomberait sur la branche "M9" → JURIDIQUE_DOWN et
  // amorcerait toute la chaîne PHX (lentRoof → declJourJ → empilementTier).
  // Gate _phxPhaseC2Active() : strict no-op tant que DTC_PHASEC2_LOTS_ENABLED
  // n'est pas posé, donc PROD/PREPROD inchangés (iso 150/150 préservé).
  if (_phxPhaseC2Active() && _phxIsLot(natalP) && !_phxLotDoctrinalAllows(natalP, code)) return null;
  if (code === "ACCIDENT" || code === "SANTE_DOWN") {
    if (PHX_ANGLES.has(natalP) || PHX_LUMINAIRES.has(natalP)) return ["angle/luminaire"];
    if (natalP === meta.chartRuler) return ["maître_ASC"];
    if (natalP === meta.almuten) return ["almuten"];
    if (code === "SANTE_DOWN" && _phxMatchLot(natalP, "Maladie")) return ["lot"];
    if ([1, 6, 8, 12].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "MARIAGE") {
    if (PHX_ANGLES.has(natalP) || PHX_LUMINAIRES.has(natalP)) return ["angle/luminaire"];
    if (natalP === meta.ruler7 || natalP === meta.chartRuler) return ["maître"];
    if (["Vénus", "Lune", "Jupiter", "Mercure"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0) return ["planète_clé"];
    if ([4, 5, 6, 7, 11].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "SEPARATION") {
      if (PHX_ANGLES.has(natalP)) return ["angle"];
      if (natalP === meta.ruler7) return ["maître_M7"];
      if (["Uranus", "Pluton", "Junon"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0) return ["planète_clé"];
      if (["Vénus", "Lune", "Mars", "Mercure", "Jupiter", "Saturne"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0) return ["planète"];
      if ([2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 12].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
      return null;
  }
  if (code === "CARRIERE_UP" || code === "CARRIERE_DOWN" || code === "SCANDALE") {
    if (PHX_ANGLES.has(natalP)) return ["angle"];
    if (natalP === meta.ruler10 || natalP === meta.chartRuler) return ["maître"];
    if (["Soleil", "Jupiter", "Vénus"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0) return ["planète_clé"];
    if (code === "SCANDALE" && (natalP === "Lot d'Éros" || natalP === "Lot d'Eros")) return ["lot"];
    if ([1, 10, 11].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "ENFANT") {
    if (["Lune", "Jupiter", "Vénus", "Soleil"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0) return ["planète"];
    if (natalP === "Imum Coeli") return ["IC"];
    if (natalP === meta.ruler5) return ["maître_M5"];
    if ([4, 5].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "RELOCATION") {
    if (natalP === "Imum Coeli") return ["IC"];
    if (natalP === "Lune" || PHX_ANGLES.has(natalP)) return ["angle/Lune"];
    if (natalP === meta.ruler4) return ["maître_M4"];
    if ([3, 4].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "DEUIL") {
    if (natalP === "Imum Coeli") return ["IC"];
    if (PHX_ANGLES.has(natalP)) return ["angle"];
    if (natalP === meta.ruler8 || natalP === meta.ruler4) return ["maître"];
    if (["Lune", "Saturne", "Pluton"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0) return ["planète"];
    if (/^Nœud/.test(natalP)) return ["nœud"];
    if ([4, 8].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "HÉRITAGE") {
    if (natalP === meta.ruler8) return ["maître_M8"];
    if (_phxMatchLot(natalP, "Héritage") || _phxMatchLot(natalP, "Heritage")) return ["lot"];
    if (h === 8) return ["M8"];
    if (PHX_ANGLES.has(natalP) || h === 4 || h === 10) return ["axe_famille"];
    if (["Pluton", "Saturne", "Jupiter", "Neptune"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0 && [4, 8, 10].indexOf(h) >= 0) {
      return ["planète_axe"];
    }
    if (["Lune", "Soleil"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0 && [4, 8].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["luminaire_axe"];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "FINANCE_UP") {
    if (["Jupiter", "Vénus", "Soleil"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0) return ["planète"];
    if (_phxMatchLot(natalP, "Fortune")) return ["lot"];
    if (natalP === meta.ruler2) return ["maître_M2"];
    if ([2, 8, 11].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "FINANCE_DOWN") {
    if (PHX_ANGLES.has(natalP)) return ["angle"];
    if (/^Nœud/.test(natalP)) return ["nœud"];
    if (natalP === meta.ruler2) return ["maître_M2"];
    if (_phxMatchLot(natalP, "Fortune") || natalP === "Part de Fortune") return ["fortune"];
    if (["Jupiter", "Vénus", "Saturne", "Neptune", "Pluton", "Uranus", "Mars"].indexOf(natalP) >= 0) return ["planète"];
    if ([2, 8].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  if (code === "JURIDIQUE_DOWN") {
    if (natalP === meta.ruler9 || natalP === meta.ruler12) return ["maître_juridique"];
    if (/^Nœud/.test(natalP)) return ["nœud"];
    if ([9, 12].indexOf(h) >= 0) return ["M" + h];
    return null;
  }
  return null;
}

// Promissors valides par code (Gemini 289 table A — H2 exclusions).
function _phxPromissorOk(code, prom) {
  if (PHX_ASTEROIDS.has(prom)) return false;
  if (PHX_ANGLES.has(prom)) return true;
  if (code === "ACCIDENT") {
    if (prom === "Jupiter" || prom === "Vénus") return false;
    return ["Mars", "Uranus", "Pluton", "Saturne"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "SANTE_DOWN") {
    if (prom === "Jupiter" || prom === "Vénus") return false;
    return ["Saturne", "Neptune", "Mars", "Pluton", "Chiron"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "MARIAGE") {
    if (prom === "Mars") return false;
    return ["Vénus", "Jupiter", "Soleil", "Lune", "Mercure"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "SEPARATION") {
    return ["Mars", "Saturne", "Uranus", "Neptune", "Pluton", "Vénus", "Soleil", "Chiron"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "CARRIERE_UP") {
    return ["Jupiter", "Soleil", "Vénus", "Mercure"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "CARRIERE_DOWN" || code === "SCANDALE") {
    return ["Saturne", "Mars", "Pluton", "Neptune", "Uranus", "Jupiter"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "ENFANT") {
    return ["Jupiter", "Vénus", "Lune", "Soleil", "Ceres", "Cérès"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "RELOCATION") {
    return ["Uranus", "Jupiter", "Lune", "Mars"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "DEUIL") {
    return ["Saturne", "Pluton", "Mars"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "HÉRITAGE") {
    return ["Saturne", "Pluton", "Jupiter", "Neptune"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "FINANCE_UP") {
    return ["Jupiter", "Vénus", "Soleil", "Lune", "Mercure"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "FINANCE_DOWN") {
    return ["Saturne", "Mars", "Neptune", "Pluton", "Uranus"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  if (code === "JURIDIQUE_DOWN") {
    return ["Saturne", "Neptune", "Pluton"].indexOf(prom) >= 0;
  }
  return false;
}

function _phxScorePermissionHit(code, layer, prom, asp, natalP, natalHouse, orb, unit, meta) {
  if (_phxAntiPattern(code, layer, prom, asp, natalP)) return null;
  if (!_phxPromissorOk(code, prom)) return null;
  if (!_phxAllowedAspects(code, prom).has(asp)) return null;
  const why = _phxSignificator(code, natalP, natalHouse, meta);
  if (!why && !(PHX_ANGLES.has(prom) && orb <= 0.3)) return null;
  const maxOrb = unit === "years" ? 1.0 : 1.0;
  if (orb > maxOrb) return null;
  const tight = unit === "years" ? orb <= 0.25 : orb <= 0.3;
  const quasiExact = layer === "ARC" && orb <= 0.1;
  return {
    layer: layer, pattern: prom + " " + asp + " " + natalP + (natalHouse ? " M" + natalHouse : ""),
    prom: prom, asp: asp, natalP: natalP, natalHouse: natalHouse,
    orb: orb, unit: unit, tight: tight, quasiExact: quasiExact,
    source: layer, why: why || ["angle_tight"],
  };
}

// Extraction permission DP + ARC.
function _phxExtractPermission(payload, meta, code) {
  const hits = [];
  const dps = payload._primaryDirections || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < dps.length; i++) {
    const dp = dps[i];
    const orbY = parseFloat(dp.orbYears);
    if (!isFinite(orbY)) continue;
    const r = _phxScorePermissionHit(code, "DP", dp.promissor, dp.aspect, dp.significator, dp.sigHouse, orbY, "years", meta);
    if (r) hits.push(r);
  }
  const lines = (payload.progressionsRaw && payload.progressionsRaw.aspects) || [];
  const text = lines.join("\n");
  const re = /ARC SOLAIRE\s*:\s*([\wœéèêàû]+(?:\s+[\wœéèêàû]+)?)\s+dirigé.+?en\s+(\w+)\s+avec\s+(\w+)\s+natal/gi;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const prom = m[1];
    const asp = m[2];
    const natalP = m[3];
    const line = text.slice(m.index, m.index + 200);
    const orbM = line.match(/orbe\s+([\d.]+)°/);
    const orb = orbM ? parseFloat(orbM[1]) : 9;
    const hM = line.match(/natal\s*\(M(\d+)/);
    const h = hM ? parseInt(hM[1], 10) : (meta.nd[natalP] && meta.nd[natalP].house);
    const r = _phxScorePermissionHit(code, "ARC", prom, asp, natalP, h, orb, "deg", meta);
    if (r) hits.push(r);
  }
  hits.sort(function (a, b) {
    if (a.tight !== b.tight) return a.tight ? -1 : 1;
    return a.orb - b.orb;
  });
  return hits;
}

// LENT_ROOF Gemini 288 H4 — cible = significateur probant du code (289).
function _phxExtractLentRoof(payload, meta, code, eventDate) {
  if ((!PHX_LENT_PERM_CODES.has(code) && code !== "HÉRITAGE") || !eventDate) return null;
  const start = _phxAddDays(eventDate, -60);
  const end = _phxAddDays(eventDate, 60);
  const hardSet = code === "SANTE_DOWN" ? PHX_HARD_SD : (code === "HÉRITAGE" ? PHX_HERITAGE_ASP : PHX_HARD);
  const block = payload._aspectsSuiviLent || {};
  let best = null;
  const keys = Object.keys(block);
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    const key = keys[i];
    const val = block[key];
    if (!val || !val.waves || !val.waves.length) continue;
    const parts = key.split("|||");
    if (parts.length < 3) continue;
    const tp = parts[0].replace(/^slow_/, "");
    const asp = parts[1];
    const np = parts[2];
    if (!PHX_LENTS.has(tp) || !hardSet.has(asp)) continue;
    const nh = val.natalHouse || (meta.nd[np] && meta.nd[np].house);
    if (!_phxSignificator(code, np, nh, meta)) continue;
    for (let j = 0; j < val.waves.length; j++) {
      const w = val.waves[j];
      const pk = w.peakDate || w.start;
      if (!_phxInWindow(pk, start, end)) continue;
      const orb = parseFloat(w.minOrb);
      if (!isFinite(orb) || orb > 1.0) continue;
      const tier = orb <= 0.5 ? "S" : "A";
      const hit = {
        layer: "LENT", pattern: tp + " " + asp + " " + np + (nh ? " M" + nh : ""),
        prom: tp, asp: asp, natalP: np,
        natalHouse: nh,
        orb: orb, tier: tier, tight: tier === "S",
        peak: pk, source: "LENT_ROOF", why: ["angle/luminaire"],
      };
      
      // Priorité absolue aux touches sur l'Ascendant ou la Maison 1 pour les codes corporels
      const isAsc = np === "Ascendant" || nh === 1;
      const bestIsAsc = best && (best.natalP === "Ascendant" || best.natalHouse === 1);
      
      if (!best) {
        best = hit;
      } else if (isAsc && !bestIsAsc && hit.tier === "S") {
        best = hit; // Un hit S sur l'Ascendant supplante n'importe quel autre hit
      } else if (!isAsc && bestIsAsc && best.tier === "S") {
        // On garde le best qui est sur l'Ascendant
      } else if (hit.tier === "S" && best.tier !== "S") {
        best = hit;
      } else if (hit.tier === best.tier && hit.orb < best.orb) {
        best = hit;
      }
    }
  }
  return best;
}

// SCANDALE — toit MC tier S (Mars/Plu/Ura/Nep), Gemini 290 H10 élargi aux transits lents sur l'image.
function _phxExtractScandaleMcRoof(payload, eventDate, meta) {
  if (!eventDate) return null;
  const start = _phxAddDays(eventDate, -60);
  const end = _phxAddDays(eventDate, 60);
  // Doctrine enrichie: Neptune, Pluton, Uranus. Mars autorisé si amas M10.
  const promSet = new Set(["Neptune", "Pluton", "Uranus", "Mars"]);
  const aspSet = new Set(["Conjonction", "Carré", "Opposition"]);
  const block = payload._aspectsSuiviLent || {};
  let best = null;
  const keys = Object.keys(block);
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    const key = keys[i];
    const val = block[key];
    if (!val || !val.waves || !val.waves.length) continue;
    const parts = key.split("|||");
    if (parts.length < 3) continue;
    const tp = parts[0].replace(/^slow_/, "");
    const asp = parts[1];
    const np = parts[2];
    if (!promSet.has(tp) || !aspSet.has(asp)) continue;
    
    const nh = val.natalHouse || (meta && meta.nd[np] && meta.nd[np].house);
    if (np !== "Milieu du Ciel" && nh !== 10) continue;
    
    for (let j = 0; j < val.waves.length; j++) {
      const w = val.waves[j];
      const pk = w.peakDate || w.start;
      if (!_phxInWindow(pk, start, end)) continue;
      const orb = parseFloat(w.minOrb);
      if (!isFinite(orb) || orb > 0.5) continue;
      const tier = orb <= 0.35 ? "S" : "A";
      
      // Mars doit être très précis (S) pour compter comme toit de scandale
      if (tp === "Mars" && tier !== "S") continue;

      const hit = {
        layer: "LENT", pattern: tp + " " + asp + " " + np + " M10",
        prom: tp, asp: asp, natalP: np, natalHouse: 10,
        orb: orb, tier: tier, tight: tier === "S",
        peak: pk, source: "LENT_ROOF", why: ["MC_scandale"],
      };
      if (!best || (hit.tier === "S" && best.tier !== "S") || hit.orb < best.orb) best = hit;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

// Déclencheurs TPROG (Mars autorisé en harmoniques).
function _phxExtractDeclencheurs(payload, meta, code, eventDate, windowDays, permDpArc, lentRoof) {
  if (!eventDate) return [];
  const hits = [];
  
  // Doctrine stricte : le déclencheur doit toucher un significateur déjà activé par la permission/toit
  const activeTargets = new Set();
  if (lentRoof) activeTargets.add(lentRoof.natalP);
  if (permDpArc) {
    for (let i=0; i<permDpArc.length; i++) activeTargets.add(permDpArc[i].natalP);
  }

  const lines = (payload.progressionsRaw && payload.progressionsRaw.aspects) || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i];
    if (line.indexOf("TRANSIT → PROGRESSÉ") < 0) continue;
    const tm = line.match(/TRANSIT → PROGRESSÉ\s*:\s*([A-Za-zÀ-ÿ]+)\s+en\s+([A-Za-zÀ-ÿ]+)\s+avec\s+([A-Za-zÀ-ÿ]+)/);
    if (!tm) continue;
    const prom = tm[1], asp = tm[2], progP = tm[3];
    if (!_phxPromissorOk(code, prom) && prom !== "Mars") {
      // Les astéroïdes ne sont autorisés que pour certains codes
      if (PHX_ASTEROIDS.has(prom)) {
        if (code === "ENFANT" && (prom === "Ceres" || prom === "Cérès")) { /* ok */ }
        else if (code === "MARIAGE" && (prom === "Junon" || prom === "Vesta")) { /* ok */ }
        else continue;
      } else {
        continue;
      }
    }
    
    if (!_phxAllowedAspects(code, prom).has(asp)) continue;
    
    // Si on a des cibles actives, le déclencheur DOIT taper dessus (ou être un angle)
    if (activeTargets.size > 0 && !activeTargets.has(progP) && !PHX_ANGLES.has(progP)) {
      if (!(code === "ENFANT" && progP === "Lune")) continue;
    }
    
    // Vérifier que la cible est un significateur valide pour le code
    const hMs_v = line.match(/\(M(\d+)\)/g);
    const progHouse_v = hMs_v ? parseInt(hMs_v[hMs_v.length - 1].replace(/\D/g, ""), 10) : null;
    if (!_phxSignificator(code, progP, progHouse_v, meta) && !PHX_ANGLES.has(progP)) continue;
    const peakMatches = [];
    let pm;
    const peakRe = /pic\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/gi;
    while ((pm = peakRe.exec(line)) !== null) peakMatches.push(pm[1]);
    if (!peakMatches.length) continue;
    let best = peakMatches[0];
    let bestAbs = Math.abs(_phxDaysFrom(eventDate, best));
    for (let k = 1; k < peakMatches.length; k++) {
      const a = Math.abs(_phxDaysFrom(eventDate, peakMatches[k]));
      if (a < bestAbs) { best = peakMatches[k]; bestAbs = a; }
    }
    const daysJ = _phxDaysFrom(eventDate, best);
    if (Math.abs(daysJ) > windowDays) continue;
    const orbM = line.match(/meilleur orbe\s+([\d.]+)°/) || line.match(/orbe\s+([\d.]+)°/);
    const orb = orbM ? parseFloat(orbM[1]) : 9;
    if (orb > 0.6) continue;
    const hMs = line.match(/\(M(\d+)\)/g);
    const progHouse = hMs ? parseInt(hMs[hMs.length - 1].replace(/\D/g, ""), 10) : null;
    // Aspects autorisés : durs + harmoniques pour Mars
    const aspectsOk = prom === "Mars" ? new Set(["Conjonction", "Carré", "Opposition", "Sextile", "Trigone"]) : PHX_HARD;
    if ((code === "SCANDALE" || code === "JURIDIQUE_DOWN" || code === "SANTE_DOWN") && prom === "Mars" && (asp === "Trigone" || asp === "Sextile")) continue;
    if (!aspectsOk.has(asp)) continue;
    hits.push({
      layer: prom === "Mars" ? "MARS_TPROG" : "TPROG",
      pattern: prom + " " + asp + " " + progP + " (prog)",
      prom: prom, asp: asp, progP: progP, progHouse: progHouse,
      orb: orb, peak: best, daysJ: daysJ,
      tight: orb <= 0.15,
      marsJourJ: prom === "Mars" && Math.abs(daysJ) <= 5,
    });
  }
  hits.sort(function (a, b) { return Math.abs(a.daysJ) - Math.abs(b.daysJ) || a.orb - b.orb; });
  return hits;
}

// Gemini 289 — planètes lentes = fenêtre transit élargie.
const PHX_SLOW_TRANSIT = new Set(["Jupiter", "Saturne", "Uranus", "Neptune", "Pluton", "Chiron"]);
const PHX_STANDALONE = [
  { code: "MARIAGE", prom: "Jupiter", targets: ["Descendant", "Vénus"], aspects: ["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Sextile"], orbMax: 1, windowDays: 30 },
  { code: "CARRIERE_UP", prom: "Jupiter", targets: ["Milieu du Ciel"], aspects: ["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Sextile"], orbMax: 1, windowDays: 30 },
  { code: "SEPARATION", prom: "Uranus", targets: ["Descendant", "Vénus"], aspects: ["Conjonction", "Carré", "Opposition"], orbMax: 1, windowDays: 30 },
  // Gemini 290 H7 — exil / migration : Ura ou Jup partile sur FC
  // Note 280 (Phase A) — RELOCATION saturait 58/150 top-1 (vs 8 vrais).
  //   Cause racine : window 180j sur transits slow (Uranus, Jupiter)
  //   capturait des aspects qui durent plusieurs mois sans rapport avec un déménagement.
  //   Correctif : orbe 0.5° (au lieu de 1°) pour exiger un partile vrai.
  //   • Uranus → IC : aspects durs ET doux (déracinement OU enracinement choisi).
  //   • Jupiter → IC : aspects doux uniquement (expansion du foyer).
  //   • Junon → MC : conservé (rare, déjà orbe 0.5°).
  { code: "RELOCATION", prom: "Uranus", targets: ["Imum Coeli"], aspects: ["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Carré", "Sextile"], orbMax: 0.5, windowDays: 30 },
  { code: "RELOCATION", prom: "Jupiter", targets: ["Imum Coeli"], aspects: ["Conjonction", "Trigone", "Sextile"], orbMax: 0.5, windowDays: 30 },
  { code: "RELOCATION", prom: "Junon", targets: ["Milieu du Ciel"], aspects: ["Conjonction"], orbMax: 0.5, windowDays: 45 },
];

function _phxScanTransitWaves(payload, eventDate, code, promFilter, aspSet, targetSet, orbMax, windowDays, meta, layerLabel) {
  const hits = [];
  if (!eventDate) return hits;
  const start = _phxAddDays(eventDate, -windowDays);
  const end = _phxAddDays(eventDate, windowDays);
  const blocks = [payload._aspectsSuiviRap || {}, payload._aspectsSuiviLent || {}];
  for (let bi = 0; bi < blocks.length; bi++) {
    const block = blocks[bi];
    const keys = Object.keys(block);
    for (let ki = 0; ki < keys.length; ki++) {
      const key = keys[ki];
      const val = block[key];
      if (!val || !val.waves || !val.waves.length) continue;
      const parts = key.split("|||");
      if (parts.length < 3) continue;
      const tp = parts[0].replace(/^(fast|slow)_/, "");
      if (promFilter && tp !== promFilter) continue;
      const asp = parts[1];
      const np = parts[2];
      if (aspSet && !aspSet.has(asp)) continue;
      if (targetSet && !targetSet.has(np)) continue;
      if (_phxAntiPattern(code, "TRANSIT", tp, asp, np)) continue;
      const nh = val.natalHouse || (meta.nd[np] && meta.nd[np].house);
      const why = _phxSignificator(code, np, nh, meta);
      if (promFilter && layerLabel !== "EXCEPTION" && !why) continue;
      for (let wi = 0; wi < val.waves.length; wi++) {
        const w = val.waves[wi];
        const pk = w.peakDate || w.start;
        if (!_phxInWindow(pk, start, end)) continue;
        const orb = parseFloat(w.minOrb);
        if (!isFinite(orb) || orb > orbMax) continue;
        const daysJ = _phxDaysFrom(eventDate, pk);
        hits.push({
          layer: layerLabel || "TRANSIT_RAPIDE",
          pattern: tp + " " + asp + " " + np + (nh ? " M" + nh : ""),
          prom: tp, asp: asp, natalP: np, orb: orb, peak: pk, daysJ: daysJ,
          tight: orb <= 0.15,
          jourJ: Math.abs(daysJ) <= 5,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  hits.sort(function (a, b) {
    const jA = a.jourJ ? 0 : 1;
    const jB = b.jourJ ? 0 : 1;
    if (jA !== jB) return jA - jB;
    return Math.abs(a.daysJ) - Math.abs(b.daysJ) || a.orb - b.orb;
  });
  return hits;
}

function _phxStandaloneWindowDays(ex) {
  if (PHX_SLOW_TRANSIT.has(ex.prom)) {
    const tg = ex.targets || [];
    for (let i = 0; i < tg.length; i++) {
      if (tg[i] === "Imum Coeli" || tg[i] === "Milieu du Ciel") return 180;
    }
  }
